objectives.name: Locate and Kill The Ferrous Wroughtnaut

title: The Living Armor
description:
Name: [Ferrous Wroughtnaut](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/wroughtnaut.png:150:150)
Known Locations: Underground
Estimated Size: Large
Behavior: Stationary until approached. Swings [Axe of a Thousand Metals](image:mowziesmobs:textures/item/wrought_axe_icon.png:50:50) in wide arcs. Armor is seemingly unbreakable, making damaging it only possible through the crack in its back.
Danger Level: §6§lMedium
